## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `install`
